role_extensions.whole_circle: a complete drawn round (cap, sides and return together) recorded as one construction, distinct from closed_ring, which is kept for eye/pupil rings
role_extensions.arch_band: thick architectural arch/vault band drawn as two or more cooperating parallel strokes (often with ﾆ/二 fill between) that turns from crown to flank; thickness belongs to the architectural form, not to every round subject
role_extensions.ellipse_rim: perspective rim of a round opening, end face or plane (vessel mouth, cylinder end, altar) recorded with its near/far or inner/outer edges and thickness, not a cap alone
role_extensions.dotted_rim: round boundary drawn as a run of leader/dot glyphs (… ‥ ．) stepping around the form, distinct from a solid contour and from a tone field
